We show here that a granule-associated cationic protein
{molecular mass, 37,000 D) purified from human PMN acts as
‘8 monocyte-specfic chemoattractant. This protein, CAP37
(cationic antimicrobial protein of molecular mass 37,000 D)
possesses substantial antimicrobial activity against a number
of gram-negative bacteria (8). Here we report on its potent
ronocyte-specific chemotactic activity, cellular localization,
purification, NHf-terminal amino acid sequence, incapacity t0
bind diisopropyl fluorophosphate (DFP),' and 89% release
from PMN during phagocytosis of Staphylococcus aureus.
